frozen_thresholds.tool_calls_bytes_and_elapsed_time: measure and report separately; no threshold invented here
frozen_thresholds.optional_ranker: compare with deterministic baseline and inspect every low-ranked gold case; scores are uncalibrated

rules: Score a factual clause only when every material proposition is supported by the cited evidence IDs.
Entity identity requires stable saved identity or an independently validated cross-snapshot join; names alone do not join.
Contradictory observations remain separate with branch/time uncertainty visible.
Separate recorded event, state observation, observed difference, and inference.
Do not infer motive, consent, moral character, death, resurrection, or causation from absence, labels, or correlation.
Distinguish guard/role labels, xenotype labels, active effects, overridden genes, and suppression state.
Represent each participant perspective as its own evidence; do not select an objective motive without support.
Unknown, ambiguous, unsupported, and incomplete coverage require abstention with a bounded evidence-seeking follow-up.
Every supplied source and case must end as found, not found, excluded with reason, failed, or blocked; no silent pruning.

private_acceptance: Mandatory local holdout; public synthetic success cannot substitute for private evidence.
